import os, subprocess, time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
p='/tmp/r/rinit.cuh'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('if (Base::can_implement(args) != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) return 201;','if (!Base::can_implement(args)) return 201;')
open(p,'w').write(s)
t=open('/tmp/r/t.cu').read().replace('<TN>','<RTN>'); open('/tmp/r/t.cu','w').write(t)
def build(tn):
    out=f'/tmp/r/r_{tn}.so'
    cmd=f'nvcc -shared -Xcompiler -fPIC -O3 -std=c++17 -gencode arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a --expt-relaxed-constexpr -I/tmp/r -I/usr/local/cutlass/include -I/usr/local/cutlass/tools/util/include -DRTN={tn} /tmp/r/t.cu -o {out} -Xptxas -v'
    r=subprocess.run(cmd,shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
    if r.returncode:
        errs=[l for l in r.stderr.split('\n') if 'error' in l]
        return 'ERR '+'\n'.join(errs[:12])+'\n'+r.stderr[:1500]
    return out + ' | ' + ' '.join(l.strip() for l in r.stderr.split('\n') if 'registers' in l or 'spill' in l)[-600:]
t0=time.time()
with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as ex: res=list(ex.map(build,[224,192,96]))
print('build',round(time.time()-t0))
for r in res: print(r[:2500])

T = textwrap.dedent(r'''
import ctypes, torch, sys
K=N=2560
ws=torch.empty(32<<20,dtype=torch.uint8,device='cuda')
torch.manual_seed(0)
W=torch.randn(N,K,device='cuda').bfloat16()
for tn, Ms in [(224,[8192,7976,256]),(192,[4096,4106,586]),(96,[2048,586,1571])]:
    lib=ctypes.CDLL(f'/tmp/r/r_{tn}.so'); o=(ctypes.c_int*3)(); lib.info(o); print(tn,'stages,accst,smem',list(o),flush=True)
    for M in Ms:
        a=torch.randn(M,K,device='cuda').bfloat16(); r=torch.randn(M,N,device='cuda').bfloat16(); d=torch.zeros(M,N,device='cuda').bfloat16()
        st=lib.launch(ctypes.c_void_p(a.data_ptr()),ctypes.c_void_p(r.data_ptr()),ctypes.c_void_p(W.data_ptr()),ctypes.c_void_p(d.data_ptr()),M,N,K,ctypes.c_void_p(ws.data_ptr()),ctypes.c_size_t(32<<20),ctypes.c_void_p(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream))
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        ref=a.float()@W.float().t()+r.float()
        e=(d.float()-ref).abs(); ok=(e<=0.02+0.05*ref.abs()).float().mean().item()
        e0=(d.float()-(ref-r.float())).abs().max().item()
        print(tn,M,'st',st,'maxerr',round(e.max().item(),3),'matched',round(ok,5),'err_vs_noR',round(e0,2),flush=True)
''')
open('/tmp/r/test.py','w').write(T)
try:

    print(r.stdout[-3000:]); print(r.stderr[-2000:])
